_comment: Mistral Chat Completions. The default reasoning ladder is none/high; hosted zai-glm Models infer low/high/max. Exact catalog ladders win over both defaults. Tool-call ids must be exactly nine alphanumerics. History replays the captured content chunks only, never a readable text field. The vision FAQ documents at most 8 images per request (another page says it depends on the Model).

family_defaults.note: Mistral's hosted GLM contract uses low/high/max and cannot disable thinking; inferred from zai-glm-5-3.

rules.note: Mistral's direct Large 4 API accepts low, medium and high and rejects none. The Zen route has its own effort contract.
